# sirf.

> sirf. is a media and content house for founders and brands with high standards. It works with five clients at a time, never a sixth, and does one thing at a time for each, with full attention. "Sirf" is Hindi and Urdu for "only".

Website: https://www.sirf.website/
Contact: sirfconvos@gmail.com
Book a 30-minute call: https://cal.com/prasan-singh/sirfyou
Founder: Prasan Singh (https://linkedin.com/in/prasan-singh)

## What sirf. does

- Brand films: commercials, brand documentaries and launch films; concept, direction, production and post.
- Content systems: always-on social and short-form content; formats, series and a publishing rhythm built around the audience.
- Campaigns & launches: the idea, the rollout, the media and every touchpoint.
- Identity & art direction: brand identity, visual language, tone of voice.
- Media: an in-house media team for shoots, stills and edits, on call and on brand.
- Strategy & distribution: positioning, channel planning, paid media and partnerships.

## Who it is for

Founders and personal brands, consumer and D2C brands, VCs and startups, and creators and media businesses who would rather have full attention than a slice of it.

## How it works

1. Listen: one conversation, done properly; learn the business before touching the brand.
2. Commit: one brief, one dedicated team.
3. Craft: the frame, the grade, the sound mix, the caption; the last 10% is where excellence lives.
4. Deliver: finished, on time, nothing half-done. Then the next thing.

Commitments: 5 clients at a time (never a sixth); 1 thing in focus per client; 0 handoffs to people the client hasn't met; 100% senior eyes on every deliverable. The process takes about 6 hours of the client's month, with one point of contact.
